shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls && git ls-files | head -50 && rg -n -i -C 3 "markdown|editor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150

cat AGENTS.md; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__ node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150
npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -60; ls node_modules | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head
npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor peerDependenciesMeta 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components katex markdown-it @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>&1 | head; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json

npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n' | grep -o '"4\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tr -d '"' | tail -25 | while read v; do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null)"; done

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 katex markdown-it @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -80; ls -R guides | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md | head -90; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView 2>&1 | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build && ls; grep -rn "initialMarkup\|initialEditorMode\|initialSplitModeEnabled\|'change'\|\"change\"" --include=*.d.ts . | head -20; grep -n "setup\|configure\|styles\|css" ../README.md | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && grep -n '"types"\|"exports"\|"main"\|"module"' package.json | head; find build/esm -name "bundle" -maxdepth 2 | head; find build/esm -path "*bundle*" -name "useMarkdownEditor.d.ts" -o -path "*bundle*" -name "Editor.d.ts" -o -name "MarkdownEditorView.d.ts" | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle && cat useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; grep -n "initial\|on(\|EditorEvent\|change\|getValue\|replace\|focus" Editor.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "Props\|className\|height\|autofocus\|settingsVisible\|toolbarsPreset" MarkdownEditorView.d.ts | head -30
cat types.d.ts | sed -n 1,140p; grep -n "change\|on(\|off(" editor-public-types.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 1,30p MarkdownEditorView.d.ts

cat editor-public-types.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p; grep -n "change\|submit\|Event" ../core/*.d.ts Editor.d.ts | grep -i "event\|change" | head -20; grep -rn "YfmStaticView" ../index.d.ts ../view/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm && cat bundle/events.d.ts | head -40; sed -n 20,40p core/Editor.d.ts; grep -n "CommonEditor" -A20 common/*.d.ts | head -30; grep -rln "YfmStaticView" --include=index.d.ts . | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && grep -n '"\./' package.json | head -30; grep -n -i "css\|yfm.css" README.md build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/allowHTML: false,/md: {html: false},/' src/MarkdownField.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
sed -i 's/allowHTML: false,/md: {html: false},/' src/MarkdownField.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
rm -rf dist && git status --short
